description.narrative: The PME Performantes WASH-Climate 2.0 programme is the second edition of a dedicated acceleration programme developed by ForthInvestment and Aqua for All. The goal is to support ten small and medium enterprises (SMEs) in the WASH sector as they scale up their operations. This programme goes beyond business growth – it brings together stakeholders and fosters networking and advocacy activities. It also incorporates a dedicated focus on climate change mitigation and adaptation. PME Performantes WASH-Climate 2.0 is deployed in partnership with IRC WASH, Sinergi Burkina, Société Générale Burkina Faso, MDF Training & Consultancy, CEAS, cewas and other public and private entities providing financing and support.Launched in November 2022, the programme will run for 18 months. After a selection and preliminary diagnostic phase of five months, ten SMEs were selected. ForthInvestment will develop tailor-made Business Development Support plans for each SME that includes technical, organisational and seed capital support for a period of thirteen months.

title.narrative: S1- Total number of current unique users served by the initiative with access to improved and safe sanitation products and services

description.narrative: Fill in total number of unique current users for sanitation. Disaggregated per: Male/Female. Type: Domestic users (private and households), school users and for other public users (e.g markets and hospitals, communal users etc) Finally disaggregate users that are provided with a Safely managed / Basic service / Limited service from the initiative. The initiative must tick all criteria to be considered as that service level. 1) Safely managed service: - the initiative provides an improved sanitation facility (this includes: flush/pour flush to piped sewer system, septic tanks or pit latrines; ventilated improved pit latrines, composting toilets or pit latrines with slabs) - the initiative's sanitation service is not shared with other households - the initiative ensures that human excreta are safely disposed in situ or transported and treated off-site 2) Basic service: - the initiative provides an improved sanitation facility (this includes: flush/pour flush to piped sewer system, septic tanks or pit latrines; ventilated improved pit latrines, composting toilets or pit latrines with slabs) - the initiative's sanitation facility is not shared with other households - initiative does not ensure that human excreta and urine is safely disposed / transported / treated 3) Limited service: Usually at baseline level, but cannot be included at target level. This includes, open pits, unimproved pit latrines, unlined pits, no slabs, prone to flooding etc \* This is indicative of the reach and scale of the initiative in reaching new users with its products and services in terms of the service level that is being provided (as defined by JMP).

title.narrative: D1 - Total number of current unique users served by the initiative with sustainable access to improved and safe drinking water products and services

description.narrative: Total nr of beneficiaries disaggregated by Male/Female and Domestic/school/public users Please also check the criteria per service level to see what level best matches your initiative. The initiative must fulfill all criteria to be considered at that service level. 1. Safely managed service: 2. the initiative provides an improved source of water (this includes: piped water, boreholes or tube wells, protected dug wells, protected springs, rainwater, packaged / bottled water, water that is delivered) 3. the initiative is located on the premises of the household or dwelling 4. the initiative provides drinking water whenever it is needed 5. the drinking water provided by the initiative has no presence of E.coli 6. the drinking water provided by the initiative contains no / limited levels of arsenic and fluoride (below WHO standards: < 0.01 mg/L arsenic and < 1.5mg/L fluoride 7. Basic service: 8. the initiative provides an improved source of water (this includes: piped water, boreholes or tube wells, protected dug wells, protected springs, rainwater, packaged / bottled water, water that is delivered) 9. the initiative provides water for users where the collection time is less than 30 minutes for a roundtrip including queuing 0. Limited service: Drinking water from an improved source for which collection time exceeds 30 minutes for a roundtrip including queuing. 1. Unimproved service: Drinking water from an unprotected dug well or unprotected spring \* This is indicative of the reach and scale of the initiative in reaching new users with its products and services in terms of the service level that is being provided (as defined by JMP).
